message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Genre | Notable Achievements |
|-------|----------------|-------|----------------------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | Fantasy | First book in the Harry Potter series; won the Nestlé Smarties Book Prize. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Fantasy | Won the British Book Awards’ Children’s Book of the Year. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the Guardian Children's Fiction Prize. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Children’s Book of the Year. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Children’s Book of the Year. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Children’s Book of the Year. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Fantasy | Won the Carnegie Medal and the British Book Awards’ Children’s Book of the Year. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Contemporary Fiction | Rowling’s first adult novel; shortlisted for the Booker Prize. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Crime/Thriller | First book in the Cormoran Strike series; received critical acclaim. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Crime/Thriller | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Crime/Thriller | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Crime/Thriller | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |

These titles have sold millions of copies worldwide and have been translated into dozens of languages. The Harry Potter series, in particular, has become a cultural phenomenon, inspiring films, merchandise, theme park attractions, and a dedicated fan community.
